findings.title: Cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: After the initial RLock check misses, every concurrent caller waits for the write lock and then unconditionally reloads assets-manifest.json and overwrites entryPointAssetsCache, even if another goroutine populated the cache while it was waiting. Because the file I/O is also performed while holding the exclusive lock, a cold-cache burst in non-Dev mode serializes redundant disk reads and blocks fast-path readers instead of only the first caller loading and the rest reusing the newly cached value. Recheck entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring Lock (when cfg.Env != Dev) and return it if non-nil.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the data-race fix
findings.body: This change adds synchronization around the global entryPointAssetsCache but adds no test that calls GetWebAssets concurrently, so the original race would not be reproduced or guarded against in CI (including with the race detector). A test should exercise parallel GetWebAssets calls on a cold cache (and, if feasible, in Dev mode where the cache is rewritten) against a temporary assets-manifest.json so a missing or incorrectly scoped lock fails under -race.
